# Circuit Schematic Analysis Skill

This folder contains the standalone circuit schematic analysis Skill and a clearly non-production example schema. Start with [SKILL.md](SKILL.md). For hardware-to-software tracing, hand off evidence to [autosar-hw-code-traceability](../autosar-hw-code-traceability/SKILL.md).

The workflow does not itself provide OCR, electrical connectivity extraction, ERC, SPICE simulation or physical verification. Use available image/CAD/netlist tools and keep unresolved evidence explicit.
